contents.text: I'm weighing whether to auto-fix again now that there are new facts. I still need to check whether the FREESHIP discount on order 1011 actually appears in the data, since the investigator says it does.

arguments.reason: The investigator confirmed that an order with SPRING15 would fail the same way: GetOrderTotal (line 18) indexes the rate table directly for any code outside WELCOME10 and VIP20. No existing order in data/orders.csv carries SPRING15, so that failure is latent, but the same fallback covers it. The investigator also found a further affected order: 1011 carries FREESHIP, which is not in the table, so it fails today. The cause is unchanged, still in code with high confidence, and the runbook allows the fix. The coder should add a TryGetValue fallback to the subtotal for any unknown code, keeping WELCOME10, VIP20 and no-code totals unchanged, and the reviewer should check that orders 1003 and 1011 now return their subtotal.
